name: Sayyida al Hurra
role: Moroccan ruler of Tétouan and privateer
contribution: A Moroccan privateer who governed the city of Tétouan from 1515 to 1542.

checks.lead: Lalla ʿĀʾisha bint ʿAlī ibn Rāshid al-ʿAlamī (Arabic: عائشة بنت علي بن رشيد العلمي), commonly known as Sayyida al-Ḥurra (السيدة الحرة, transl. The Lady, the Free lady), was a Moroccan privateer who governed the city of Tétouan from 1515 to 1542. As the wife of Moroccan king Abu al-Abbas Ahmad ibn Muhammad, who was her second husband, she belonged to the Wattasid dynasty. She is considered to be "one of the most important female figures of the Islamic West in the modern age."
